note: Retries: gentler Pegasus loop (wings went plastic on full flaps) and a dissolve-style dragon-to-pegasus transition (dragon turned cartoonish when it flew).

runs.label: loop-pegasus-gentle
runs.prompt: A locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. A heroic oil painting gently comes alive; keep the visible oil brushstrokes and the painted feathers in every frame, the horse and wings always look painted, never smooth, never 3D. Pegasus holds its pose in the sky; its great wings rise and fall only slightly and slowly, like breathing, the feather tips stirring in the wind. Its mane and tail stream and ripple strongly in the wind. The white clouds below churn and drift slowly. The deep blue sky on the left stays calm. Majestic and slow, a seamless loop.

runs.label: trans-dragon-to-pegasus-mist
runs.prompt: One slow, continuous painterly transformation, like ink dissolving in water. The ink dragon slowly melts into the drifting mist and becomes part of the clouds. The mist rises and swells into large billowing clouds and fills the picture. The pale paper colour slowly deepens into a rich cobalt blue sky behind the clouds, and the ink washes become thick oil-painted brushstrokes. The clouds part and reveal a white winged horse, Pegasus, already rearing in the sky with its wings spread. Every frame looks like a painting, with visible brushwork: no 3D, no cartoon, no photorealism.
